candidates.title_zh: 照片转桌面收藏手办与包装
candidates.author: GeminiApp
candidates.evidence_grade: A: platform-owned response; cached snapshot freshness unknown
candidates.prompt_en: Convert the subject in the uploaded photo into a realistic painted collectible figure displayed on a desk. Preserve distinctive facial features, outfit and pose while making the materials clearly miniature resin and plastic. Place it on a clear circular stand, with a matching illustrated retail box nearby and a monitor showing the same figure as a modeling wireframe. Use natural desktop lighting.
candidates.reason_zh: 官方具体案例互动6338赞；用户、宠物、家人都可作为主体，个性化使用门槛低。
candidates.notes_zh: 已视觉核对官方附图；只是一张手办效果图，非可3D打印模型。

candidates.title_zh: 同一产品九宫格品牌故事板
candidates.author: Dari_Designs
candidates.evidence_grade: A: platform-owned response; cached snapshot freshness unknown
candidates.prompt_en: Using the uploaded product photo, design a 3-by-3 campaign contact sheet. Keep the container, label and brand palette consistent across all nine panels. Include a hero shot, packaging close-up, human interaction, material detail, repeated arrangement, floating product, texture macro, still life and usage scene. Use coherent lighting, even gutters and a 4:5 canvas.

candidates.notes_zh: 本帖5179赞属于九宫格成品展示；原始prompt帖2012178722615329176另有2484赞，不能相加。两帖均已核验。

candidates.title_zh: 复古掌机像素对战画面

candidates.evidence_grade: A: platform-owned response; cached snapshot freshness unknown

Preserve crisp pixel clusters without smoothing, on a 4:3 canvas.

candidates.title_zh: 国家立体地形旅行指南

candidates.title_zh: 真人照片转一致姿态的3D角色
candidates.author: firatbilal
candidates.evidence_grade: A: platform-owned response; cached snapshot freshness unknown
candidates.prompt_en: Restyle the uploaded portrait as an expressive stylized 3D character. Preserve the person’s pose, clothing colors, hairstyle and camera angle. Match the original scene layout and use soft cinematic lighting with natural depth of field.

candidates.notes_zh: 选择原始prompt帖3324赞；后续Super Bowl展示帖1645赞不重复计入。
